name: GK SOUND SYSTEM
shortDescription: A local-first Windows media player with deep DSP control and a focused playback experience.
fullDescription: GK SOUND SYSTEM is a Windows media player designed around local playback, practical audio control and a private-by-default workflow. It combines everyday library features with a 20-band equalizer and DSP tools for listeners who want more control without handing their media to a cloud service.
features: Windows media player with offline and local-first operation
20-band EQ and DSP controls for bass, treble, clarity, stereo widening, AGC and reverb
True gapless playback, playlists, favorites, lyrics, Mini Player and Theater/full-screen modes
MP3, FLAC, WAV, AAC/M4A, OGG, Opus, WMA, AIFF and MP4 playback
Video playback routed through the same DSP-focused experience
seoTitle: GK SOUND SYSTEM — Local-first Windows media player
seoDescription: Explore GK SOUND SYSTEM, a local-first Windows media player with 20-band EQ, DSP controls, gapless playback and broad media format support.
